message.content: ```python import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.glide import GlideIE @pytest.fixture def extractor(): """Return a fresh GlideIE instance.""" return GlideIE() def test_normal_extraction(extractor, monkeypatch): """Test normal extraction with all fields present.""" sample_webpage = """ Damon's Glide message """ # Patch the download method to return our sample webpage monkeypatch.setattr(extractor, "_download_webpage", lambda url, video_id: sample_webpage) result = extractor._real_extract("http://share.glide.me/UZF8zlmuQbe4mr+7dCiQ0w==") assert result["id"] == "UZF8zlmuQbe4mr+7dCiQ0w==" assert result["title"] == "Damon's Glide message" assert result["url"] == "https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4" assert result["thumbnail"] == "https://cdn.example.com/thumb.jpg" def test_missing_title_fallback(extractor, monkeypatch): """If is missing, fallback to og:title.""" sample_webpage = """ <html> <head></head> <body> <meta property="og:title" content="Fallback Title"> <video> <source src="https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4" type="video/mp4"> </video> <img id="video-thumbnail" src="https://cdn.example.com/thumb.jpg"> </body> </html> """ monkeypatch.setattr(extractor, "_download_webpage", lambda url, video_id: sample_webpage) result = extractor._real_extract("http://share.glide.me/UZF8zlmuQbe4mr+7dCiQ0w==") assert result["title"] == "Fallback Title" def test_missing_video_url_fallback(extractor, monkeypatch): """If <source> is missing, fallback to og:video:url.""" sample_webpage = """ <html> <head><title>Damon's Glide message """ monkeypatch.setattr(extractor, "_download_webpage", lambda url, video_id: sample_webpage) result = extractor._real_extract("http://share.glide.me/UZF8zlmuQbe4mr+7dCiQ0w==") assert result["url"] == "https://cdn.example.com/fallback.mp4" ```
